units.source_zh: “是的，甚至有人说干脆求求大人，搬到您住的滨松城去。

units.source_en: Those farmers and fishermen have ever so many wishes and grievances.”

ja.t: たちには、まだまだたくさんの

units.source_zh: 那些农夫、渔民，还有好多愿望和牢骚呢。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是的，甚至有人说干脆求求大人，搬到您住的滨松城去。那些农夫、渔民，还有好多愿望和牢骚呢。”

paragraphs.source_en: Hachibē rose and went home to prepare his clothing, while Ieyasu silently watched him depart. To think that they were already so near Ogoi, where his mother had long resided—it was almost as though he had returned to Mikawa. Nor were the local people merely flattering him when they said they wished to live near Ieyasu.

units.source_en: Hachibē rose and went home to prepare his clothing, while Ieyasu silently watched him depart.
units.source_zh: 八兵卫起身回家准备衣物，家康默默地目送着他离去。

units.source_en: To think that they were already so near Ogoi, where his mother had long resided—it was almost as though he had returned to Mikawa.
units.source_zh: 想不到，这里已经离母亲住了很长时间的阿古居如此近了，和回到三河差不多了。

units.source_en: Nor were the local people merely flattering him when they said they wished to live near Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 这一带的百姓说想住到家康身边去，也绝非讨好之言。

paragraphs.source_zh: 八兵卫起身回家准备衣物，家康默默地目送着他离去。想不到，这里已经离母亲住了很长时间的阿古居如此近了，和回到三河差不多了。这一带的百姓说想住到家康身边去，也绝非讨好之言。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, Ieyasu ate the vegetarian meal Kenkū brought him, then left Shōjū-in under the guidance of the village headman Hachibē. By then, the hills ahead were already alive with a chorus of cicadas.

units.source_en: Before long, Ieyasu ate the vegetarian meal Kenkū brought him, then left Shōjū-in under the guidance of the village headman Hachibē.
units.source_zh: 不久，家康吃了显空拿来的斋饭，然后在庄屋八兵卫的引领下，离开了正住院。

units.source_en: By then, the hills ahead were already alive with a chorus of cicadas.
units.source_zh: 此时，前面的山冈上早已是蝉声一片。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不久，家康吃了显空拿来的斋饭，然后在庄屋八兵卫的引领下，离开了正住院。此时，前面的山冈上早已是蝉声一片。

paragraphs.source_en: “Tadatsugu, the cicadas here seem to sing rather differently from those in Naniwa and the port of Sakai.”

units.source_en: “Tadatsugu, the cicadas here seem to sing rather differently from those in Naniwa and the port of Sakai.”
units.source_zh: “忠次，这里蝉鸣声似和难波、堺港的蝉声不大一样啊。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “忠次，这里蝉鸣声似和难波、堺港的蝉声不大一样啊。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Indeed. Even the cicadas seem to sing with a Mikawa accent.”

units.source_en: “Indeed. Even the cicadas seem to sing with a Mikawa accent.”
units.source_zh: “是啊，连蝉声都很像三河腔啊。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是啊，连蝉声都很像三河腔啊。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Tadatsugu, once we reach Okazaki, assemble the troops at once and lead them to Atsuta.”

units.source_en: “Tadatsugu, once we reach Okazaki, assemble the troops at once and lead them to Atsuta.”
units.source_zh: “忠次，到冈崎之后，你立刻把军兵召集起来，带到热田去。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “忠次，到冈崎之后，你立刻把军兵召集起来，带到热田去。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Then, my lord, you do not mean to lead the vanguard...?”

units.source_en: “Then, my lord, you do not mean to lead the vanguard...?”
units.source_zh: “这么说，主公不打头阵……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这么说，主公不打头阵……”
